reference.text: Look at the crowds of water-gazers there.

underlines.text: will content them but the extremest limit of the land

reference.text: Its extreme downtown is the battery, where that noble mole is washed by waves, and cooled by breezes, which a few hours previous were out of sight of land.

underlines.text: do not mean to have it inferred that I ever go to sea as a passenger

reference.text: Why upon your first voyage as a passenger, did you yourself feel such a mystical vibration, when first told that you and your ship were now out of sight of land?

underlines.text: gets his atmosphere at second hand from the sailors on the forecastle

reference.text: No, when I go to sea, I go as a simple sailor, right before the mast, plumb down into the forecastle, aloft there to the royal mast-head.
